fusions.name: Droning Round
fusions.desc: Hums 3 notes at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stray Sting
fusions.desc: Flicks a barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Shared Comb
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Following Swarm
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm follows in your wake and fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
